metadata.description: Synthetic cause-effect task-set instance #32 at scale 3 (pure-sampling, fingerprint-noise=0.1).
metadata.reference_schedule: placement (cpu_id, core_id) is a reference allocation under which every task meets its deadline with partitioned preemptive fixed-priority scheduling and deadline-monotonic priorities (ties broken by period, then task name).  Jobs are released at earliest_activation + k * period, possibly delayed by up to max_jitter (release jitter); deadlines are relative to the nominal release.  Verified by jitter-aware response-time analysis, which holds for arbitrary offsets; see check.py.
